subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should `artifacts.download` return session-bound managed-image bytes under the existing `operator.read` artifact contract after all URL, session, record, transcript, and coordinate bindings pass?
rationale: Repository trust-model evidence supports the proposed read scope, but this changes which authorization class can receive local bytes and therefore requires an explicit Gateway-owner decision rather than an automated verdict.

options.title: Confirm `operator.read`
options.body: Keep the current RPC scope and require exact-head allowed/denied live proof before merge.

options.title: Require `operator.admin`
options.body: Change the handler, protocol wording, tests, and Control UI recovery together so read-only operators do not receive managed bytes.

options.title: Pause the RPC path
options.body: Keep the current protected HTTP behavior and pause this PR if neither scope has an owner-approved contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm `operator.read`
recommendation.body: Keep the current RPC scope and require exact-head allowed/denied live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion already routes the permanent Gateway authorization contract to this recent contributor to the same managed-image HTTP boundary.
